description: Reserved external node collecting the platform-facing measurement view (the same names the generated controller code reads via the platform_api shim): raw phase currents, DC link + phase voltages, sin/cos encoder counts, temperatures, speeds, dclink instantaneous power/current, plus optional truth-side power diagnostics (twin harness tw_p_heat_w / tw_p_dc_w / tw_p_shaft_em_w). Port names mirror the twin's measurement keys verbatim and must not be renamed without a twin-side schema rev. Unwired channels collect NaN (unpopulated -> null in JSONL).

inputPorts.name: Iu_A
inputPorts.description: Measured phase current U, A.

inputPorts.name: Iv_A
inputPorts.description: Measured phase current V, A.

inputPorts.name: Iw_A
inputPorts.description: Measured phase current W, A.

inputPorts.name: Vdc_V
inputPorts.description: Measured DC link voltage, V.

inputPorts.name: Vu_V
inputPorts.description: Measured phase voltage U, V (MAX22530 view).

inputPorts.name: Vv_V
inputPorts.description: Measured phase voltage V.

inputPorts.name: Vw_V
inputPorts.description: Measured phase voltage W.

inputPorts.name: Enc_Sin
inputPorts.description: Encoder sin raw counts (optional: unpopulated rigs collect NaN->null).

inputPorts.name: Enc_Cos
inputPorts.description: Encoder cos raw counts (optional: unpopulated rigs collect NaN->null).

inputPorts.name: Temp_Inv1_C
inputPorts.description: NTC baseplate reading TS1, C. (optional: bare-rail rigs have no NTC strip; unwired -> NaN/null).

inputPorts.name: Temp_Inv2_C
inputPorts.description: NTC baseplate reading TS2, C. (optional: bare-rail rigs have no NTC strip; unwired -> NaN/null).

inputPorts.name: Temp_Inv3_C
inputPorts.description: NTC baseplate reading TS3, C (often null/unpopulated).

inputPorts.name: Temp_Motor_C
inputPorts.description: Motor thermistor reading, C (often null).

inputPorts.name: Mech_Rpm
inputPorts.description: Mechanical speed, RPM. (optional: no-shaft rigs; unwired -> NaN/null).

inputPorts.name: Elec_Rpm
inputPorts.description: Electrical speed, RPM (mech*pp). (optional: no-shaft rigs; unwired -> NaN/null).

inputPorts.name: Dclink_I_A
inputPorts.description: DC-link current (regen-feed sign), A.

inputPorts.name: Dclink_P_W
inputPorts.description: DC-link power (regen-feed sign), W.

inputPorts.name: P_Heat_W
inputPorts.description: Truth: heat into the baseplate NTC chain (Loss.P_Plate), W.

inputPorts.name: P_Dc_W
inputPorts.description: Truth: power drawn from the link (machine air-gap + total losses), W.

inputPorts.name: P_ShaftEm_W
inputPorts.description: Truth: machine air-gap electromechanical power (P_Elec), W.
